action.reason: Spec conflict: subagent-runs.ts costForTurn() includes all pending background spend. If a background run finishes before its starting send persists metadata, turn-runner.ts charges that starting turn. Spec line 261 explicitly requires reporting it on the next turn, not the starting turn.

rationale: The spot-check found concrete accounting behavior that conflicts with the spec. Green gates and complete branch-review coverage do not waive that requirement.
